static_traits.name: Zhou Lan
static_traits.family_status: Living on a boat with spouse
static_traits.social_status: Has a close friend to talk with, but rarely discusses with them due to embarrassment over marital doubts
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological problems or psychotherapy experiences in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logic, capable of self-Reflection and highly cooperative; emotions dominated by Anxiety, tending to focus on negative details and compare with others

basic_info.main_problem: I have always felt our marriage continues only because my husband is too kind to end it; these doubts began at our first anniversary.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent doubt and negative thoughts cause marked distress, affecting marriage and daily life; hopes through counseling to relieve these thoughts and pain, restore work focus, and improve the relationship.

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of being loved
Only a marriage meeting others'/social standards counts as good

special_situations.event: Sees seemingly happy, perfect couples (such as in daily life or social scenes) and makes comparisons
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If our relationship does not meet society's so-called 'perfect marriage' standard, it means the marriage has problems and I am not loved
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly comparing oneself with others, seeking comfort and confirmation from one's spouse but finding it hard to take in positive evidence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Our marriage is not as good as others'; he may just be too kind to leave me

special_situations.event: Having a minor disagreement or argument with husband
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If he really loved me, he would not argue with me; any argument means he is tired of me and ready to leave
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Over-interpreting the other's actions after arguments, staying vigilant and distant for Self-protection or repeatedly seeking confirmation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He must have had enough of me and may be planning to leave me

special_situations.event: After an argument, the husband calms down, gives space, comes back to communicate, and is supportive and comforting normally
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I still feel doubtful, it means his comfort is not out of love but out of kindness or politeness
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate positive evidence, focusing only on negative cues to maintain doubt and defensiveness
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He is just too kind-hearted to feel comfortable suggesting separation

special_situations.event: Milestone moments like the first anniversary trigger thoughts of 'are we good/happy enough'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the first year was not 'perfect', happiness later will be hard and the relationship may be doomed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Inferring the whole and the future from single/short-term experiences, using more comparisons to seek 'certainty'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: We have only barely held on until now; from here it will only get worse

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be loved, confirmed, and in a long-term commitment, gaining safety and intimacy in the relationship
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being abandoned, Being rejected, or not being truly loved; fear of the relationship not measuring up and being negated
defense_goal: Reducing the blow of being abandoned through anticipatory suspicion and excessive vigilance
Maintaining a psychological 'sense of control' by negating positive evidence
Explains relationships through a social-standards framework to avoid facing vulnerable attachment needs

object_relations.self_representation: A flawed partner who may not be loved
object_relations.object_representation: An overly kind spouse who could leave at any moment

object_relations.self_representation: Someone not measuring up, needing to be fixed

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When small relationship friction or arguments arise
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Projecting the Fear of abandonment as 'he will surely leave me' (transference: attributing inner unease to the other's intentions)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Asserts the other party's intentions with affirmative sentences (such as 'he must be tired of me'), tone hurried, ignoring evidence to the contrary.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the spouse shows patience, support, and comfort
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turning the longing to be loved and uncertainty into the Interpretation that he is just 'kind/polite'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: The tone is calm but distant, interpreting positive care as 'out of kindness rather than love', avoiding expressing genuine vulnerable needs.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about whether the marriage meets society's 'perfect standard'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Replacing subjective emotional experience with abstract standards and concepts, emphasizing 'measuring up / not measuring up' judgments
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Heavily using abstract and judgmental terms (e.g., 'societal standards' 'perfect marriage'), avoiding describing present concrete feelings.

manifestations: Continuously doubting my spouse's love and commitment, hard to internalize comfort and support
Feeling the relationship 'does not measure up' after comparing with others, producing estrangement
outcomes: Increased Anxiety and unease, Sleep affected
Relationship tension and declining intimacy, Daily functioning impaired

manifestations: Evaluates the relationship's value by society's 'perfect marriage' standards, ignoring the positive parts of one's own experience
outcomes: Declining trust and investment in the relationship, producing emptiness and confusion

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Measures self-worth and relationship value by society's standard of a 'perfect marriage'
When comparing others' relationships, overlooks the uniqueness and positive experiences in one's own

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Embarrassed to express marital doubts, so reduces asking friends for help
Frequent Self-doubt, excessive attention to negative cues

positive_force: Spouse is stable, patient, and willing to communicate and comfort
The client has self-observation ability, can notice their own focus on the negative, and is willing to seek help
Has some social support (one friend to confide in)
Motivated to improve relationships and restore functioning, willing to try reality testing and reframing perspectives
negative_force: Excessive comparison and external-standard orientation, relying on society's 'perfect marriage' judgment
Marked cognitive distortions (mind reading, overgeneralization, negating the positive, mental filtering)
Worry about abandonment with low tolerance for uncertainty, tending toward catastrophic inferences
Persistent negative rumination affecting sleep, self-care, and work focus
Ashamed to seek support; positive evidence is hard to internalize

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly doubting spouse's love and commitment (negative rumination and vigilance)
antecedent: Having a minor disagreement or argument with husband
Seeing seemingly happy couples and comparing
Recalling milestone moments like the first wedding anniversary
Getting distracted at work, associating to marital problems
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of abandonment with low tolerance for uncertainty, developing catastrophic and overgeneralized Interpretations under the influence of society's 'perfect marriage' standard
target_behavior.function: In the short term seeks certainty through doubt and vigilance, avoiding the emotional blow of being abandoned
target_behavior.consequence: Strained Marriage and relationships, Decline in work performance, impaired sleep and self-care, intensifying negative cycle
